descriptionHtml: A webinar on ‘Introduction to 5G Technology and 5G Security’ under "SPLENDOUR' was held at 6.00 p.m. on 24th July 2021 via zoom. It was organized by the Industrial Application Society (IAS, IEEE) of University of Peradeniya. The webinar was conducted by Mr. Yushan Siriwardhana, Doctoral student at center for wireless communications, University of Oulu, Master's degree in wireless communications engineering.
